name: Heritage 202 Center
summary: Heritage 202 Center is a well-positioned neighborhood shopping center in affluent Somers, New York, serving a high-income community along Route 202. The 19,258 square foot property attracts over 510,000 annual visits from residents in one of Westchester County's most desirable areas.
demographics: Heritage 202 Center serves an affluent suburban community in Somers, New York, with a trade area population of 21,323 within three miles. The primary market consists of high-income households averaging $208,985 annually, living in homes valued at approximately $687,730. The daytime population of 17,674 includes professionals working in the area, complementing the residential base. With over 510,000 annual visits, the center attracts families and professionals seeking convenient neighborhood shopping in a well-established community near golf courses and schools.
description: Heritage 202 Center is a neighborhood shopping destination strategically positioned at 249 Route 202 in Somers, New York, serving one of Westchester County's most affluent communities. Developed and managed by Regency Centers, this 19,258 square foot property sits at the corner of a thriving residential area surrounded by upscale homes, prestigious golf courses, and quality schools. The center benefits from its prime location along U.S. Route 202, providing convenient access to a trade area with an exceptional average household income exceeding $200,000 and home values approaching $700,000. With over half a million annual visits, Heritage 202 Center has established itself as a trusted neighborhood hub where local residents can access essential services and retail offerings. The property exemplifies Regency Centers' commitment to developing thriving community centers that serve as integral gathering places in growing suburban markets.
